blocks.prompt: 10. Setting \(h = 0.5\), use the trapezium rule to find the approximate area bounded by the curve \(y = e^{x^{2}}\) from the line \(x = 0\) to the line \(x = 4\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh kis qisam ka sawal hai: definite integral ki value Trapezium Rule se approximately nikalni hai, seedha integration nahi karna.
Diya kya hai? Function \(f(x) = e^{x^{2}}\), interval \([0, 4]\), aur \(h = 0.5\) diya hai, to pehle \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\) nikalna hoga.
Find kya karna hai? Integral ki approximate value, chaar decimal places tak.
Rule kaunsa aur kyun? Trapezium Rule, kyunke sawal yahi maangta hai: area ko barabar chaurai ki pattiyon (trapeziums) mein baant kar jama karna.
Plan: h ya n, phir points ki list, phir har point par function ki value, phir beech wali values ka jama, aur aakhir mein formula aur tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = e^{x^{2}}\), \(a = 0\), \(b = 4\), \(h = 0.5\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{0}^{4} e^{x^{2}}\,dx\) ki approximate value.
Tareeqa: sawal khud Trapezium Rule maang raha hai, is liye wohi lagayenge. Yahan \(n\) nahi balke \(h = 0.5\) diya hai, is liye pehle \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\) nikalenge. Phir points aur un par function ki values (chaar decimal tak) nikal kar formula \(\frac{h}{2}[\text{pehli} + 2(\text{beech wali}) + \text{aakhri}]\) mein rakhenge.

Continuity
\(e^{x^{2}}\) do continuous functions (\(x^{2}\) aur exponential) ka composition hai, is liye \([0, 4]\) par continuous hai. Yeh hamesha positive hai, is liye integral seedha area hi hai.
Kyun: Trapezium Rule continuous function ke liye bana hai; agar graph beech mein toot jaye to trapeziums us hisse ko sahi nahi dhaanp sakte.

Subintervals ki tadaad aur points
\[n = \dfrac{b-a}{h} = \dfrac{4-0}{0.5} = 8\]
Points \(x_{i} = a + ih\): \(0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4\)
Kyun: \(h = \frac{b-a}{n}\) ko ulat kar \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\) milta hai, yani poori lambai mein \(h\) kitni dafa aata hai. 8 subintervals ke 9 points hain; har agla point pichle se \(h\) aage hai.

Function values (4 decimal places)
\[f(0) = e^{0} = 1.0000\]
\[f(0.5) = e^{0.25} = 1.2840\]
\[f(1) = e^{1} = 2.7183\]
\[f(1.5) = e^{2.25} = 9.4877\]
\[f(2) = e^{4} = 54.5982\]
\[f(2.5) = e^{6.25} = 518.0128\]
\[f(3) = e^{9} = 8103.0839\]
\[f(3.5) = e^{12.25} = 208981.2889\]
\[f(4) = e^{16} = 8886110.5205\]
Kyun: har point ko function mein rakha. Pehle square: \(e^{(3.5)^{2}} = e^{12.25}\), \(e^{4^{2}} = e^{16}\). Values bohat tezi se barhti hain (aakhri value 88 lakh se upar hai), is liye poori likhein aur dhyan se jama karein.
Dhyan dein: \(e^{x^{2}}\) aur \((e^{x})^{2} = e^{2x}\) alag hain; misaal \(x = 4\) par \(e^{16}\) aur \(e^{8}\) mein bohat bara farq hai.
Neeche jawab ke saath di gayi table mein yahi values un ke weights (1 ya 2) ke saath hain.

Beech wali values jama karein
\[S = f(x_{1}) + \dots + f(x_{7})\]
\[= 1.2840 + 2.7183\]
\[+ 9.4877 + 54.5982\]
\[+ 518.0128 + 8103.0839\]
\[+ 208981.2889\]
\[= 217670.4738\]
Kyun: yeh 7 beech wali values har ek do saath wale trapeziums ki saanjhi deewar hain, is liye formula mein in ka jama do dafa (double) aayega. Pehle in ka jama alag nikal lena hisaab ko saaf aur check karne ke qabil banata hai.

Trapezium Rule apply karein
\[\int_{0}^{4} e^{x^{2}}\,dx\]
\[\approx \dfrac{h}{2}\big[f(x_{0}) + 2S + f(x_{8})\big]\]
\[= 0.25\big[1.0000 + 2(217670.4738)\]
\[+ 8886110.5205\big]\]
\[= 0.25(9321452.4681)\]
\[= 2330363.12\]
\[\approx 2.3304 \times 10^{6}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{h}{2} = 0.25\). Kinaron wali do values ek ek dafa aayin aur beech wali values ka jama do dafa; phir poore bracket ko \(\frac{h}{2}\) se zarb diya. Round sirf aakhri jawab ko kiya, beech mein nahi, taake ghalti jama na ho.

Tasdeeq:
\(e^{x^{2}}\) ka bhi elementary antiderivative nahi. Computer bohat zyada subintervals le kar taqreeban \(1.1494 \times 10^{6}\) deta hai, yani hamara jawab taqreeban double hai. Wajah: curve \(x = 3.5\) par 208981 se \(x = 4\) par 8886111 tak uchhalta hai; aakhri trapezium ki seedhi chhat curve se bohat upar rehti hai aur akela woh taqreeban \(2.27 \times 10^{6}\) de deta hai. Aise tez charhne wale (steep, concave up) curve ke liye bohat chhota h chahiye. Sawal ne h = 0.5 hi maanga hai, is liye jawab yahi hai, lekin yeh samajhna zaroori hai ke yeh approximation kamzor hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key \(2.3203 \times 10^{6}\) likhti hai. Bracket \(1 + 2(217670.4738) + 8886110.5205 = 9321452.4681\) hai aur \(0.25 \times 9321452.4681 = 2330363.12\), is liye sahi jawab \(2.3304 \times 10^{6}\) hai (key ke digits ghalat chhap gaye lagte hain).
